notes.title: Update Patch 1.0
notes.notes:
Update Patch 1.0 is now available. Here are the details:

Fixes


 Cursor Glitch in Main Menu
 Cursor Toggle in Inventory


Improvements


 Improved AI Pathfinding (Navigation) on all maps
 Improved Random Loot Spawn in Horde Mode


Specific Changes

Non Police AI:


 Increased Health 
 Increased Max Damage
 Increased Wandering Radius


Police AI:


 Reduced Fire Rate
 Decreased Accuracy
 Increased Damage
 Increased Ammo Capacity
 Increased Wandering Radius


New


 Police Vehicles Now Have Emergency Lights On


Know bugs


 Some NPC's do not take damage when hit in some parts of a body


What's Next


 Address issues from above
 Urination System
 Create Pause System
 Improve Main Menu


PS: Urination System has been already added, but for some reason it doesn't work in game build. It definitely will by next Update Patch though.

notes.title: Fuck The Police Release
notes.notes:
It's been a long journey for the game to be out right now. I truly appreciate Steam Support for straight forwardness with me while this game was in review queue. But it's out now and what really matters is, is the future content for the game.

I will personally say though, Fuck The Police game isn't perfect at this moment. For the most part, in-game AI isn't where it supposed to be, but I think I have my eyes on the right path. Updates shall follow.

Now, let's talk about the Civil War Mode. That's something I've been working over the past week and it's essentially "One versus everyone" game-mode where you fight against Police Force, Trumpkins, Antifa and of course, Karens.

Like I said, NPC's aren't where I want them to be, but the time will come. Now, are you ready to and for Fuck The Police? 

Lock and Load.
Over and Out.
